newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Swedish EMU membership an open question-Persson.
newsitem.headline: Swedish EMU membership an open question-Persson.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Tuesday the country's decision on whether to join European Economic and Monetary Union was "still an open question".
He told a news conference that the decision would be taken in the autumn, first in the party congress of the ruling Social Democrats and then in parliament in October or November.
Persson, on an official visit to Luxembourg, stressed that a decision on EMU must be anchored in Swedish society.
"And if I should judge now from the Swedish opinion, it's a negative decision. But you don't know. Much can happen and it is still an open question," he said.
